# Pipe queries over the tests' tables, run by GoogleSQL's execute_query 2026.11.1 over the same
# rows: each query, its columns and their types, and its rows as the table mode prints them,
# sorted, or its error.
# Generated by scratch/projects/pipe-parser/queries/record_queries.py from cases_5a.txt.
FROM t |> UNION ALL (FROM u)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"], ["3", "c"], ["4", "d"]]
FROM t |> UNION DISTINCT (FROM u), (FROM u)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"], ["3", "c"], ["4", "d"]]
FROM t |> INTERSECT DISTINCT (FROM u)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["2", "b"]]
FROM t |> EXCEPT DISTINCT (FROM u)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM t |> UNION ALL (FROM t) |> INTERSECT ALL (FROM t |> UNION ALL (FROM u))	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM t |> UNION ALL (FROM t) |> EXCEPT ALL (FROM t |> WHERE x = 1)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM t |> UNION ALL (FROM u |> SELECT x * 1.5 AS y, s)	["x DOUBLE", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"], ["3", "b"], ["4.5", "c"], ["6", "d"]]
FROM t |> UNION ALL (FROM u |> SELECT s, x)	ERROR	Column 1 in UNION ALL has incompatible types: INT64, STRING
FROM t |> UNION ALL BY NAME (FROM u |> SELECT s, x)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"], ["3", "c"], ["4", "d"]]
FROM t |> FULL UNION ALL BY NAME (FROM u |> SELECT s, x AS w)	["x INT64", "s STRING", "w INT64"]	[["1", "a", "NULL"], ["2", "b", "NULL"], ["3", "NULL", "NULL"], ["NULL", "b", "2"], ["NULL", "c", "3"], ["NULL", "d", "4"]]
FROM t |> LEFT UNION ALL BY NAME (FROM u |> SELECT s, x AS w)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"], ["NULL", "b"], ["NULL", "c"], ["NULL", "d"]]
FROM t |> INNER UNION ALL BY NAME (FROM u |> SELECT s, x AS w)	["s STRING"]	[["NULL"], ["a"], ["b"], ["b"], ["c"], ["d"]]
FROM t |> UNION ALL CORRESPONDING (FROM u |> SELECT s, x AS w)	["s STRING"]	[["NULL"], ["a"], ["b"], ["b"], ["c"], ["d"]]
FROM t |> UNION ALL STRICT CORRESPONDING (FROM u |> SELECT s, x)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"], ["3", "c"], ["4", "d"]]
FROM t |> UNION ALL CORRESPONDING BY (s) (FROM u)	["s STRING"]	[["NULL"], ["a"], ["b"], ["b"], ["c"], ["d"]]
FROM t |> FULL UNION ALL BY NAME ON (s, w) (FROM u |> SELECT s, x AS w)	["s STRING", "w INT64"]	[["NULL", "NULL"], ["a", "NULL"], ["b", "2"], ["b", "NULL"], ["c", "3"], ["d", "4"]]
FROM t |> UNION ALL BY NAME (FROM u |> SELECT s)	ERROR	BY NAME requires all input queries to have identical column names, but pipe input table has [x, s] and pipe argument query 1 has [s]
FROM t |> UNION ALL (FROM u |> SELECT x)	ERROR	Queries in UNION ALL have mismatched column count; pipe input table has 2 columns, pipe argument query 1 has 1 column
FROM t AS q |> UNION ALL (FROM u) |> SELECT q.x	ERROR	Unrecognized name: q
FROM sales |> AGGREGATE SUM(m) AS total GROUP BY ROLLUP (sp, isl)	["sp STRING", "isl STRING", "total INT64"]	[["A", "NULL", "3"], ["A", "x", "1"], ["A", "y", "2"], ["B", "NULL", "8"], ["B", "x", "5"], ["B", "y", "3"], ["NULL", "NULL", "11"]]
FROM sales |> AGGREGATE SUM(m) AS total GROUP BY CUBE (sp, isl)	["sp STRING", "isl STRING", "total INT64"]	[["A", "NULL", "3"], ["A", "x", "1"], ["A", "y", "2"], ["B", "NULL", "8"], ["B", "x", "5"], ["B", "y", "3"], ["NULL", "NULL", "11"], ["NULL", "x", "6"], ["NULL", "y", "5"]]
FROM sales |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((sp, isl), sp, ())	["sp STRING", "isl STRING", "n INT64"]	[["A", "NULL", "2"], ["A", "x", "1"], ["A", "y", "1"], ["B", "NULL", "2"], ["B", "x", "1"], ["B", "y", "1"], ["NULL", "NULL", "4"]]
FROM sales |> AGGREGATE SUM(m) AS total GROUP BY sp, ROLLUP (isl)	["sp STRING", "isl STRING", "total INT64"]	[["A", "NULL", "3"], ["A", "x", "1"], ["A", "y", "2"], ["B", "NULL", "8"], ["B", "x", "5"], ["B", "y", "3"]]
FROM sales |> AGGREGATE SUM(m) AS total GROUP BY ()	["total INT64"]	[["11"]]
FROM sales |> EXTEND SUM(m) OVER w AS run WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY sp ORDER BY isl)	["sp STRING", "isl STRING", "m INT64", "run INT64"]	[["A", "x", "1", "1"], ["A", "y", "2", "3"], ["B", "x", "5", "5"], ["B", "y", "3", "8"]]
FROM sales |> SELECT sp, m, RANK() OVER (w ORDER BY m DESC) AS r WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY sp)	["sp STRING", "m INT64", "r INT64"]	[["A", "1", "2"], ["A", "2", "1"], ["B", "3", "2"], ["B", "5", "1"]]
FROM sales |> SELECT sp, m, SUM(m) OVER b AS r WINDOW a AS (PARTITION BY sp), b AS (a ORDER BY m)	["sp STRING", "m INT64", "r INT64"]	[["A", "1", "1"], ["A", "2", "3"], ["B", "3", "3"], ["B", "5", "8"]]
FROM sales |> SELECT SUM(m) OVER (w PARTITION BY isl) AS r WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY sp)	ERROR	If a window has a PARTITION BY, it cannot reference a named window
FROM sales |> SELECT SUM(m) OVER nope AS r	ERROR	Unrecognized window alias nope
FROM sales |> PIVOT (SUM(m) FOR sp IN ('A', 'B'))	["isl STRING", "A INT64", "B INT64"]	[["x", "1", "5"], ["y", "2", "3"]]
FROM sales |> PIVOT (SUM(m) AS s, COUNT(*) AS n FOR sp IN ('A', 'B' AS b))	["isl STRING", "s_A INT64", "n_A INT64", "s_b INT64", "n_b INT64"]	[["x", "1", "1", "5", "1"], ["y", "2", "1", "3", "1"]]
FROM sales |> PIVOT (SUM(m) FOR isl IN ('x', 'z')) AS p |> SELECT p.sp, p.x	["sp STRING", "x INT64"]	[["A", "1"], ["B", "5"]]
FROM sales |> PIVOT (SUM(m) + 1 AS t FOR sp IN ('A'))	ERROR	PIVOT expression must be an aggregate function call
FROM sales |> PIVOT (SUM(m) FOR sp IN (1))	ERROR	PIVOT IN list item must be type STRING to match the PIVOT FOR expression; found INT64
FROM sales PIVOT (MAX(m) FOR sp IN ('A', 'B'))	["isl STRING", "A INT64", "B INT64"]	[["x", "1", "5"], ["y", "2", "3"]]
FROM wide |> UNPIVOT (v FOR col IN (a, b))	["k INT64", "c INT64", "d INT64", "v INT64", "col STRING"]	[["1", "3", "4", "10", "a"], ["2", "NULL", "NULL", "2", "b"], ["2", "NULL", "NULL", "20", "a"]]
FROM wide |> UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (v FOR col IN (a AS 'first', b AS 'second'))	["k INT64", "c INT64", "d INT64", "v INT64", "col STRING"]	[["1", "3", "4", "10", "first"], ["1", "3", "4", "NULL", "second"], ["2", "NULL", "NULL", "2", "second"], ["2", "NULL", "NULL", "20", "first"]]
FROM wide |> UNPIVOT ((v1, v2) FOR g IN ((a, b), (c, d)))	["k INT64", "v1 INT64", "v2 INT64", "g STRING"]	[["1", "10", "NULL", "a_b"], ["1", "3", "4", "c_d"], ["2", "20", "2", "a_b"]]
FROM wide |> UNPIVOT ((v1, v2) FOR g IN ((a, b) AS 1, (c, d) AS 2)) AS w |> SELECT w.g, w.v1	["g INT64", "v1 INT64"]	[["1", "10"], ["1", "20"], ["2", "3"]]
FROM wide |> UNPIVOT ((v1) FOR g IN ((a, b)))	ERROR	The number of output value columns does not match the number of columns in each column group of the UNPIVOT IN clause
FROM wide UNPIVOT (v FOR col IN (c, d))	["k INT64", "a INT64", "b INT64", "v INT64", "col STRING"]	[["1", "10", "NULL", "3", "c"], ["1", "10", "NULL", "4", "d"]]
FROM sales |> TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (100 PERCENT)	["sp STRING", "isl STRING", "m INT64"]	[["A", "x", "1"], ["A", "y", "2"], ["B", "x", "5"], ["B", "y", "3"]]
FROM sales |> TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (0 PERCENT)	["sp STRING", "isl STRING", "m INT64"]	[]
FROM sales |> TABLESAMPLE RESERVOIR (2 ROWS) |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n	["n INT64"]	[["2"]]
FROM sales |> TABLESAMPLE RESERVOIR (1 ROWS PARTITION BY sp) WITH WEIGHT |> SELECT sp, weight	["sp STRING", "weight DOUBLE"]	[["A", "2"], ["B", "2"]]
FROM sales |> TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (100 PERCENT) WITH WEIGHT AS w |> SELECT w	["w DOUBLE"]	[["1"], ["1"], ["1"], ["1"]]
FROM sales |> TABLESAMPLE RESERVOIR (10 ROWS) REPEATABLE (7) |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n	["n INT64"]	[["4"]]
FROM sales |> TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (2 ROWS)	ERROR	BERNOULLI/ROWS is not supported
FROM sales TABLESAMPLE RESERVOIR (3 ROWS) |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n	["n INT64"]	[["3"]]
FROM t |> WHERE s NOT LIKE ANY ('a%', 'b%')	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"]]
FROM t |> WHERE s NOT LIKE ALL ('a%', 'x%')	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["2", "b"]]
FROM one |> SELECT CAST(DATE '2024-01-05' AS STRING FORMAT 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS v	["v STRING"]	[["2024/01/05"]]
FROM one |> SELECT CAST('05.01.2024' AS DATE FORMAT 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS v	["v DATE"]	[["2024-01-05"]]
FROM one |> SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2024-01-05 13:04:05' AS STRING FORMAT 'HH12:MI:SS PM') AS v	["v STRING"]	[["01:04:05 PM"]]
FROM one |> SELECT CAST('2024-01-05 13:04' AS DATETIME FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS v	["v DATETIME"]	[["2024-01-05 13:04:00"]]
FROM sales |> AGGREGATE SUM(m HAVING MAX m) AS a, ANY_VALUE(isl HAVING MIN m) AS b GROUP BY sp	["sp STRING", "a INT64", "b STRING"]	[["A", "2", "x"], ["B", "5", "y"]]
FROM sales |> AGGREGATE COUNT(* HAVING MAX m) AS n	["n INT64"]	[["1"]]
FROM sales |> AGGREGATE ARRAY_AGG(m ORDER BY m DESC LIMIT 1) AS a, STRING_AGG(isl, ',' ORDER BY isl LIMIT 1) AS b GROUP BY sp	["sp STRING", "a ARRAY<INT64>", "b STRING"]	[["A", "[2]", "x"], ["B", "[5]", "x"]]
FROM sales |> AGGREGATE COUNT(m LIMIT 1) AS n	ERROR	Aggregate function COUNT does not support LIMIT in arguments
FROM (FROM t |> SELECT STRUCT(x AS a, s AS b) AS st) |> SELECT st.* EXCEPT (b)	["a INT64"]	[["1"], ["2"], ["3"]]
FROM (FROM t |> SELECT x AS st) |> SELECT st.*	ERROR	Dot-star is not supported for type INT64
FROM one |> SELECT INTERVAL '1-2' YEAR TO MONTH AS v	["v INTERVAL"]	[["1-2 0 0:0:0"]]

FROM one |> SELECT INTERVAL '-3 -4:5:6.25' DAY TO SECOND AS v	["v INTERVAL"]	[["0-0 -3 -4:5:6.250"]]
FROM one |> SELECT INTERVAL '25:61' HOUR TO MINUTE AS v	["v INTERVAL"]	[["0-0 0 26:1:0"]]
